messages.content: Can you help me find public libraries in New York, NY that have a Reading Room and Fiction section, and then in Los Angeles, CA that offer Wi-Fi and have a Children Section, and finally in Chicago, IL that have a Cafe and a Reading Room?

function.name: public_library_find_nearby
function.description: Locate nearby public libraries based on specific criteria like English fiction availability and Wi-Fi. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. Boston, MA

facilities.description: Facilities and sections in public library.

message.reasoning:
The user wants us to locate nearby public libraries based on specific criteria. They want libraries in three cities:

1. New York, NY with Reading Room and Fiction section.
2. Los Angeles, CA with Wi-Fi and Children Section.
3. Chicago, IL with Cafe and Reading Room.

We need to use the function `public_library_find_nearby` from the namespace `functions`. We can call it multiple times or combine into one request? The function signature expects location (string) and facilities (one of the enumerated values). But we need to pass multiple facilities? The type says facilities: "Wi-Fi" | "Reading Room" | "Fiction" | "Children Section" | "Cafe"[]; That seems ambiguous: It might accept an array of strings? The description says "Facilities and sections in public library." So maybe we should pass an array of desired facilities. But the type shows union of string or array? Actually it's "Wi-Fi" | "Reading Room" | "Fiction" | "Children Section" | "Cafe"[], which means either one of those strings or an array of "Cafe"? That doesn't make sense. Possibly they intended facilities to be an array of strings. We'll assume we can pass an array of strings.

Thus we need to call the function thrice, each time passing location and facilities array.

We'll do first call: location: "New York, NY", facilities: ["Reading Room", "Fiction"].

Second call: location: "Los Angeles, CA", facilities: ["Wi-Fi", "Children Section"].

Third call: location: "Chicago, IL", facilities: ["Cafe", "Reading Room"].

We will produce calls accordingly.
